entries.title: Psalms 123:1
segments: ¶<A Song of the going up.> To you my eyes are lifted up, even to you whose seat is in the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 123:2
segments: See! as the eyes of servants are turned to the hands of their masters, and the eyes of a servant-girl to her owner, so our eyes are waiting for the Lord our God, till he has mercy on us.

entries.title: Psalms 123:3
segments: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us: for all men are looking down on us.

entries.title: Psalms 123:4
segments: For long enough have men of pride made sport of our soul.
